_comment: INFINITE DRAW IS A COLOUR SOURCE -- MTG_COMBO_OFF_DIG_COLOR, and this fixture is the only
thing that exercises it, because the lever ships DEFAULT OFF (the `env` block pins it on, so
it is tested rather than dead code).
USER, 2026-09-11: 'Another thing that should be possible for the Blue or Black requirement is
drawing into Fertile Ground. If you have infinite draw you can always draw into Fertile
Ground and get all the colours you need.'
The board is deliberately COLOURLESS-AND-GREEN: Conservatory+Overgrowth ({G}/{W}, +{G}{G}),
a Brushland ({G}/{W}/{C}), Emiel the Blessed and two Peregrine Drakes. Not one blue or black
source anywhere, and no land Aura in play, so comborules::HasBlueOrBlackSource is false and
rules IN-HAND / WISH-DRAW / WISH-NODRAW all decline -- and FinishNeedMana refuses BOTH
sideboard finishers on colour (Dimensional Infiltrator {1}{U}, Essence Depleter {2}{B}).
The loop itself is fine: Emiel blinks for {3}, the Drake untaps five, the set is worth 4, so
net +1 and -- because Emiel spends no {C} pip -- net_c +1 off the single Brushland.
A Fertile Ground is still in the library, and a Living Wish behind it. With a repeatable draw
source live (Conservatory's {4},{T}: Investigate) the line reaches both, so the colour the
finisher's cast needs is one dig away. DigReachesAnyColorAura says so and FinishNeedMana
stops vetoing on the one colour an any-colour Aura supplies.
WHY THE LEVER IS DEFAULT OFF, and it is not the arithmetic. ApplyBlinkLoop has exactly three
hand-cast sites -- DeployPipFreeOutletFromHand (src/core/SpellEffects.h:12272),
ComboFinishFromHand route 1 (:11653) and route 2 (:11714) -- and every one is gated on
IsCreature() (:12280, :11523). The only code that can ATTACH a land Aura is
ResolveEnchantTarget (:2547), reachable solely from the ordinary CastFromHand resolution,
which the go-off apply never enters. So the engine cannot yet run the line the user
describes, and firing on it by default would be firing on hope. `combo_off_verify` is false
here for exactly that reason: the OFFER is what this fixture pins, and it is what the
widening is. The day a DeployLandAuraFromHand sibling exists and is called from the iteration
loop, flip the default and set combo_off_verify back to true.
Its negative control is edf_co_25 -- the same board with every any-colour Aura gone from the
library, which must stay ABSENT with the lever still on.
